_metadata.description: Production React UI on react-vite + vrooli-default: a dashboard, a per-scenario validation view (findings + remediation + autofix preview/apply), a fleet inventory, a migration advisor, and an isolation-readiness scorecard. Isolation status is the primary visual anchor.

requirements.title: Dashboard and per-scenario validation view
requirements.description: A dashboard summarizing fleet storage health and a per-scenario validation view that lists findings grouped by maturity rung with remediation text and an autofix preview/apply affordance. Ladder-driven status semantics (L2 isolation = destructive red, hygiene = amber, advisory = muted).

validation.notes: The validation view renders findings grouped by rung with remediation and an autofix affordance; vitest coverage meets the gate.
Accessibility (axe) passes and data-testid selectors are stable.

requirements.title: Fleet inventory, migration advisor, and isolation scorecard
requirements.description: A fleet inventory view (filter by engine / isolation readiness / stage), a migration-advisor view (ranked candidates + per-scenario fitness), and an isolation-readiness scorecard surfacing each scenario's L2 verdict and the exact unwired seam where applicable.

validation.notes: The fleet inventory filters by engine and isolation readiness; the scorecard surfaces the L2 verdict per scenario.
